ex.en: There's a guy in my yoga class.
ex.zh: 我的瑜伽課上有個男生。

ex.en: I do yoga every morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早上做瑜伽。

ex.en: Amy teaches yoga at a gym near the office.
ex.zh: Amy 在公司附近的健身房教瑜伽。

yoga.en: a set of exercises for the body and mind that includes stretching and slow breathing

ex.en: My father retired to make way for younger people.
ex.zh: 我爸爸退休是為了讓位給年輕人。

ex.en: She is young but very experienced.
ex.zh: 她很年輕，但經驗很豐富。

young.en: having lived for only a short time

ex.en: I have an older brother and a younger sister.
ex.zh: 我有一個哥哥和一個妹妹。

ex.en: Mary is the youngest of the three sisters.
ex.zh: 瑪麗是三姊妹中年紀最小的。

ex.en: My father must have been handsome in his youth.
ex.zh: 我爸爸年輕時一定很帥。

ex.en: In her youth, my mother was very beautiful.
ex.zh: 我媽媽年輕時非常漂亮。

ex.en: Whenever I hear that song, I remember my youth.
ex.zh: 每次聽到那首歌，我就想起自己的青春歲月。

youth.en: the time of life when a person is young

ex.en: The youth of our land are not interested in politics.
ex.zh: 我們國家的年輕人對政治不感興趣。

ex.en: The city built a new youth center.
ex.zh: 市政府蓋了一座新的青年活動中心。

ex.en: The youngsters played basketball in the park all afternoon.
ex.zh: 年輕人整個下午都在公園打籃球。

ex.en: He is a bright youngster with a bright future.
ex.zh: 他是個聰明的年輕人，前途一片光明。

ex.en: Do you want some more water?
ex.zh: 你還想要一點水嗎？

ex.en: Thank you for helping me with my homework.
ex.zh: 謝謝你幫我寫功課。

ex.en: I will see you all at the party tomorrow.
ex.zh: 明天派對上再見啦，各位。

ex.en: Is this your umbrella?
ex.zh: 這是你的雨傘嗎？

ex.en: Don't forget to bring your passport.
ex.zh: 別忘了帶你的護照。

ex.en: Thank you for sharing your ideas with us.
ex.zh: 謝謝你們跟我們分享你們的想法。

ex.en: Please help yourself to some tea.
ex.zh: 請自己倒點茶喝。

ex.en: You should be proud of yourself.
ex.zh: 你應該為自己感到驕傲。

ex.en: Did you make this bag yourself?
ex.zh: 這個包包是你自己做的嗎？

york.zh: 約克（英格蘭北部的歷史古城與郡）

ex.en: York is a historic city in northern England.
ex.zh: 約克是英格蘭北部的一座歷史古城。

ex.en: Many tourists visit York to see its old walls.
ex.zh: 許多遊客到約克參觀古老的城牆。

ex.en: We took a train from London to York.
ex.zh: 我們從倫敦搭火車到約克。

ex.en: Yorkshire is a large county in the north of England.
ex.zh: 約克郡是英格蘭北部的一個大郡。

ex.en: We spent a weekend hiking in the hills of Yorkshire.
ex.zh: 我們在約克郡的山丘上健行了一個週末。

ex.en: This umbrella is mine, and that one is yours.
ex.zh: 這把傘是我的，那把是你的。

ex.en: Our house is small, but yours is much bigger.
ex.zh: 我們的房子很小，但你們的大多了。

ex.en: Is this phone yours, or does it belong to Tom?
ex.zh: 這支手機是你的，還是湯姆的？

ex.en: Yo, are you coming to the game tonight?
ex.zh: 嘿，你今晚會來看比賽嗎？

ex.en: "Yo!" he shouted across the street when he saw his friend.
ex.zh: 他在街對面看到朋友，大喊了一聲「喲！」

ex.en: She has a youthful face for her age.
ex.zh: 以她的年紀來說，她有一張年輕的臉。

ex.en: The coach praised the team's youthful energy.
ex.zh: 教練稱讚球隊年輕的活力。

ex.en: I had yogurt with fresh fruit for breakfast.
ex.zh: 我早餐吃了加新鮮水果的優格。

ex.en: This yogurt is too sweet for me.
ex.zh: 這個優格對我來說太甜了。

ex.en: Please help yourselves to some snacks.
ex.zh: 請自行取用點心。

ex.en: You should be proud of yourselves for finishing the project.
ex.zh: 你們應該為自己完成這個專案感到驕傲。

ex.en: I like my egg yolk soft and runny.
ex.zh: 我喜歡蛋黃半熟流動的。

ex.en: Separate the yolk from the white before mixing.
ex.zh: 混合前先把蛋黃和蛋白分開。

ex.en: I have yoghurt with fruit and honey for breakfast.
ex.zh: 我早餐吃加了水果和蜂蜜的優格。

ex.en: Plain yoghurt can be used instead of cream in many recipes.
ex.zh: 很多食譜中可以用原味優格代替鮮奶油。

ex.en: Yoruba is a language spoken in West Africa.
ex.zh: 約魯巴語是西非使用的一種語言。

ex.en: The Yoruba people live mainly in Nigeria and nearby countries.
ex.zh: 約魯巴人主要居住在奈及利亞及鄰近國家。

ex.en: The farmer placed a wooden yoke on the oxen.
ex.zh: 農夫把木製牛軛套在牛身上。

ex.en: The people finally escaped the yoke of foreign rule.
ex.zh: 人民終於擺脫了外國統治的枷鎖。

ex.en: The farmer yoked two oxen to pull the plow.
ex.zh: 農夫把兩頭牛套上軛來拉犁。

ex.en: The two companies were yoked together by a long contract.
ex.zh: 這兩家公司被一份長期合約緊緊綁在一起。

ex.en: My younger sister is still in elementary school.
ex.zh: 我妹妹還在念國小。

ex.en: He looks much younger than his real age.
ex.zh: 他看起來比實際年齡年輕許多。

ex.en: The older kids helped the younger ones cross the street.
ex.zh: 大孩子幫助年紀較小的孩子過馬路。

ex.en: Tickets are free for the younger of the two children.
ex.zh: 兩個孩子中年紀較小的那一位可以免費入場。

ex.en: A Yorkshireman is someone who comes from Yorkshire in northern England.
ex.zh: 約克郡人指的是來自英格蘭北部約克郡的人。

ex.en: The tour guide was a proud Yorkshireman who loved talking about his home county.
ex.zh: 導遊是個以家鄉為傲的約克郡人，很愛聊他的故鄉。

ex.en: Look at yon hill, where the sun is setting.
ex.zh: 看那邊的山丘，太陽正在那裡落下。

ex.en: The old song speaks of yon river and the green valley.
ex.zh: 那首老歌唱到遠處的河流和綠色山谷。
